segments.summary: Reviewed every core line across DP-058 through DP-062, retired DP-001, DP-063, migration coverage, the ledger compile addendum, and the trailing concrete repair addendum. Exact policy strengths include target-bound approval identity, ordered revalidation, domain-specific approval scope, non-mutating planning authority, contextual durable reuse, explicit bridge retirement, and a mutation clarification gate. Adversarial review found open identity-validation, race, outcome-consumer, research-safety, cross-document reuse, and clarification-lifecycle contracts.
